Constructed with time-worn reddish-gray Bát Tràng bricks, the courtyard exudes an aura of antiquity and reverence. These bricks, a hallmark of traditional Vietnamese craftsmanship, blend harmoniously with the lush green lawns that flank either side of the central pathway, creating a serene environment that invites contemplation and study.
